checked.comment: Generic family F with divergence satisfying Assumption 2. The family is not expressible in the vocabulary, so it is correctly described in unmapped.
1-sub-Gaussian distributions with means in the finite range R, matching Lemma 4.
SPEF with means in a known range, as assumed for TS* in Corollary 2 and Lemma (bcp_spef).
Gaussian with unknown variance, known mean lower bound and known variance upper bound. Mapping to exponential_family is acceptable, with the details in unmapped.
Support [0,B] with B known. Recorded as bounded_01 with the rescaling noted in unmapped; acceptable.
Centered h-moment family with a known lower bound on the means.
Theorem 1: E[N_k(T)] <= (1+c) log T / D_pi + o_c(log T), for c > lim a_n. Recorded correctly as a pull-count bound.
Lemma 4: problem-independent bound K^{1/4}T^{3/4} ∧ sqrt(KT(log K + a_T^{-1})) up to absolute constants.
Corollary 2, first bullet: MED is asymptotically optimal on SPEF.
Corollary 2, second bullet: TS* with Jeffreys prior is asymptotically optimal when the means lie in a known range.
Corollary 3: MED with a_n = 4/n is asymptotically optimal on Gaussians with known mean lower bound and variance upper bound.
Corollary 3: Gaussian TS* with shape parameter alpha < 0 is asymptotically optimal.
Corollary 4: MED with the K_inf divergence for F_B is asymptotically optimal.
Corollary 5: MED is asymptotically optimal on F_{h,B}.
Corollary 6: MED is asymptotically optimal on the centered family F^c_{h,B}.
Theorem 3: h-NPTS pull-count bound in terms of Lambda_gamma^star.

missing_results.description: MED with any divergence satisfying Assumption 4 (and alpha_n = 1 in (A4)) admits the problem-independent bound of Lemma 4, i.e. K^{1/4}T^{3/4} ∧ sqrt(KT(log K + a_T^{-1})), on a general family F.
missing_results.quote: If MED is implemented with a sequence $(a_n)_{n \in \N}$ and a divergence $D$ satisfying Assumption~\ref{ass::reduction_sg} on $\cF$, and in addition that $\alpha_n=1$ in (A4) for all $n\in \N$, then it admits the problem-independent bound of Lemma~\ref{lem::pb_ind_sg}.

summary: The extraction is accurate. Settings, algorithms, registry ids and all eleven results match the paper's statements: Theorem 1, Lemma 4, Corollaries 2–6 and Theorem 3, with asymptotic-optimality claims mapped to the K_inf/KL Lai–Robbins form. I found no errors that need correcting. The only gap is Proposition 1, which extends Lemma 4's problem-independent bound to MED with general divergences; it is mentioned only in r2's notes and has no result of its own.
